Application Data.NAME: Mountain Gear Outfitters
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Mountain View Lane, Suite 200, Bend, OR 97701-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mountain Gear Outfitters specializes in the retail sale of camping and outdoor equipment, offering a wide range of products including tents, sleeping bags, climbing gear, hiking apparel, and outdoor accessories. Our store is committed to providing high-quality merchandise from reputable brands, ensuring both safety and performance for all outdoor enthusiasts. We operate from a secure location equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, and maintain rigorous safety protocols to prevent accidents and liability claims. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to helping customers find the right gear for their adventures and offers product demonstrations to enhance customer experience, all while adhering to strict safety guidelines.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a theft incident occurred at our store, resulting in the loss of inventory, specifically high-value camping equipment, valued at $2,500. The theft was captured on our surveillance cameras, and a police report was filed. The claim status was resolved, with the loss being covered by our insurance policy. No injury claims were associated with this incident.
